# 1. Setup

## 1.1 Packages

```{r packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# CRAN
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(grid)
library(circlize)
library(vegan)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(multcompView)
library(openxlsx)
library(ranacapa)        # ggrare() - remotes::install_github("gauravsk/ranacapa")

# Bioconductor
library(phyloseq)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(DESeq2)
library(apeglm)
library(ALDEx2)
library(ANCOMBC)

# Global seed (NMDS, PERMANOVA permutations, rarefaction, ALDEx2 Monte-Carlo, jitter)
set.seed(123)
```

# 2. File paths and directories

```{r paths}
# Change to your own directory
base_path  <- "path/to/project"
output_dir <- file.path(base_path, "output")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

asv_file      <- file.path(base_path, "ASV_table_taxonomy.csv")
metadata_file <- file.path(base_path, "Metadata_Varieties.csv")
symptoms_file <- file.path(base_path, "Symptoms.csv")

# Note: setwd() inside an R Markdown chunk only applies to that chunk.
# All paths are therefore built explicitly with file.path().
```

# 3. Data import and phyloseq object

```{r import}
# ASV table + taxonomy (check.names = FALSE keeps sample names exactly as in the file)
df_raw <- read.csv(asv_file, sep = ";", header = TRUE,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

tax_ranks <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")

# Taxonomy table
tax_table_df <- df_raw[, c("ASV", tax_ranks)]
rownames(tax_table_df) <- tax_table_df$ASV
tax_table_df$ASV <- NULL

# ASV count table (samples in rows, ASVs in columns)
asv_table <- df_raw[, setdiff(names(df_raw), c("taxonomy", "ASV", "ID", tax_ranks))]
asv_table <- t(as.matrix(asv_table))
colnames(asv_table) <- df_raw$ASV

# Metadata
metadata <- read.csv2(metadata_file)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$SampleID

# Keep samples present in both tables
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(asv_table), rownames(metadata))
message("Samples in ASV table: ", nrow(asv_table),
        " | in metadata: ", nrow(metadata),
        " | kept: ", length(common_samples))
stopifnot(length(common_samples) > 0)

asv_table <- asv_table[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
metadata  <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# Numeric count matrix
asv_matrix <- apply(asv_table, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(asv_matrix) <- rownames(asv_table)

ps16S_raw <- phyloseq(otu_table(asv_matrix, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
                      sample_data(metadata),
                      tax_table(as.matrix(tax_table_df)))
ps16S_raw
```

# 4. Filtering

```{r filtering}
# Remove ASVs unassigned at Kingdom or Phylum level
ps16S_filtered <- subset_taxa(ps16S_raw, !is.na(Kingdom) & !is.na(Phylum))

# Remove plant (Viridiplantae), mitochondrial and chloroplast sequences.
# grepl() is used so that (i) ASVs with NA at these ranks are KEPT (a plain "!=" test
# drops every NA row) and (ii) the filter works with or without rank prefixes ("f__").
# Chloroplasts are tested at both Class (Greengenes) and Order (SILVA) levels.
ps16S_filtered <- subset_taxa(
  ps16S_filtered,
  !grepl("Viridiplantae", Kingdom) &
    !grepl("Mitochondria", Family) &
    !grepl("Chloroplast", Class) &
    !grepl("Chloroplast", Order)
)

# Root dataset: exclusion of variety "PhkarRumduol_GM" (see Methods for justification)
ps16S_Root <- subset_samples(ps16S_filtered, Variety != "PhkarRumduol_GM")

# Removal of ASV "16125" (see Methods for justification)
ps16S_Root <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps16S_Root) != "16125", ps16S_Root)

# Remove low-abundance ASVs (total count < 10 reads)
ps16S_Root_10 <- phyloseq::filter_taxa(ps16S_Root, function(x) sum(x) >= 10, prune = TRUE)

message("ASVs - raw: ", ntaxa(ps16S_raw),
        " | after taxonomic filtering: ", ntaxa(ps16S_filtered),
        " | root dataset (>= 10 reads): ", ntaxa(ps16S_Root_10))
```

# 5. Normalisation and subsets

```{r normalisation}
# Rarefaction to the minimum sequencing depth (used for beta-diversity analyses)
ps16S_Root_10_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps16S_Root_10, rngseed = 123,
                                        sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps16S_Root_10)),
                                        replace = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)

# Control plants
ps16S_control         <- subset_samples(ps16S_Root, Condition == "Control")
ps16S_control_10      <- phyloseq::filter_taxa(ps16S_control, function(x) sum(x) >= 10, prune = TRUE)
ps16S_control_10_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps16S_control_10, rngseed = 123,
                                           sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps16S_control_10)),
                                           replace = FALSE)

# Inoculated plants
ps16S_inoc         <- subset_samples(ps16S_Root, Condition == "Inoculated")
ps16S_inoc_10      <- phyloseq::filter_taxa(ps16S_inoc, function(x) sum(x) >= 10, prune = TRUE)
ps16S_inoc_10_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps16S_inoc_10, rngseed = 123,
                                        sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps16S_inoc_10)),
                                        replace = FALSE)
```

# 6. Phenotypic data (symptoms and plant size)

```{r symptoms}
symp_df <- read.csv(symptoms_file, sep = ";", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(SampleID) & SampleID != "") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Symptoms_up = as.numeric(Symptoms_up),
                Size        = as.numeric(Size)) %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Symptoms_up, Size)

# Merge into the rarefied phyloseq object (keep only the core design columns
# to avoid duplicated .x / .y columns)
curr_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10_rare))
curr_meta$SampleID <- rownames(curr_meta)

core_cols <- c("SampleID", "Variety", "Condition", "Group")
curr_meta <- curr_meta[, colnames(curr_meta) %in% core_cols]

new_metadata <- dplyr::left_join(curr_meta, symp_df, by = "SampleID")
rownames(new_metadata) <- new_metadata$SampleID

sample_data(ps16S_Root_10_rare) <- sample_data(new_metadata)

# Expected: SampleID, Variety, Condition, Group, Symptoms_up, Size
print(colnames(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10_rare)))
```

```{r palettes}
colors_Variety <- c("Leak"         = "#7CAE00",

                    "Russey"       = "#FFC000",

                  "PhkarRumduol_Control" = "#00BFC4", "PhkarRumduol_Inoculated" = "#00EDF5",

                  "Russey_Control"       = "#FFC000", "Russey_Inoculated"       = "#FFD65C")

condition_colors <- c("Control" = "#009E73", "Inoculated" = "#D55E00")

# Venn diagram gradient
color_venn <- c(low = "#F2EBBBFF", high = "#7F1019")
```

# 8. Main figures

## Fig. 1 - Taxonomic heatmap (top 30 species, control roots)

```{r fig1}
# Control plants, IR64 excluded
ps16S_control_sub <- subset_samples(ps16S_control, Variety != "IR64")

# Agglomerate at species level and convert to relative abundance (%)
ps_species     <- tax_glom(ps16S_control_sub, taxrank = "Species", NArm = FALSE)
ps_species_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_species, function(x) 100 * x / sum(x))

df_melted <- psmelt(ps_species_rel) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Genus_Clean   = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus %in% c("NA", ""), "Unclassified", Genus),
    Species_Clean = ifelse(is.na(Species) | Species %in% c("NA", ""), "sp.", Species),
    Genus_Species = paste(Genus_Clean, Species_Clean, sep = " ")
  )

# Mean relative abundance per variety.
# Several taxa can share the same label (e.g. two "Genus sp."), so abundances are
# first summed per sample, then averaged across samples of each variety.
mean_abundance_per_variety <- df_melted %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, Variety, Genus_Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variety, Genus_Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

# Top 30 species ranked by the sum of variety means
top30_global_list <- mean_abundance_per_variety %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus_Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(MeanAbundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(TotalAbundance)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 30)

top30_wide <- mean_abundance_per_variety %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus_Species %in% top30_global_list$Genus_Species) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Variety, values_from = MeanAbundance, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Genus_Species, top30_global_list$Genus_Species))

write.xlsx(top30_wide, file = file.path(output_dir, "Table_Top30_Species_by_Variety_Root.xlsx"))

# Heatmap
mat_root <- top30_wide %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Genus_Species") %>%
  as.matrix()

annotation_df <- data.frame(Variety = colnames(mat_root), row.names = colnames(mat_root))
ann_colors    <- list(Variety = colors_Variety[colnames(mat_root)])

col_fun_root <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 20),
  c("white", "#EDF7DE", "#E4F2CF", "#D2E9AF", "#B7DC7F", "#93CA3F",
    "#7DB030", "#5B8023", "#44601A", "#22300D", "black")
)

heatmap_root <- Heatmap(
  mat_root,
  name            = "Abundance (%)",
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_order    = colnames(mat_root),
  show_row_dend   = FALSE,
  width           = unit(5, "cm"),
  top_annotation  = HeatmapAnnotation(df = annotation_df, col = ann_colors),
  col             = col_fun_root,
  row_names_side  = "right",
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  rect_gp         = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1)
)

svg(file.path(output_dir, "Fig1_Heatmap_Top30_Root.svg"), width = 7, height = 8)
draw(heatmap_root)
dev.off()
```

## Fig. 2A - Alpha diversity (observed richness, control plants)

```{r fig2a}
alpha_div  <- estimate_richness(ps16S_control_10, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))
alpha_data <- cbind(data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_control_10)), alpha_div)

kw_test <- kruskal.test(Observed ~ Variety, data = alpha_data)

p_alpha <- ggplot(alpha_data, aes(x = Variety, y = Observed, fill = Variety)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.5, width = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
  labs(title = "A. Observed ASV richness (control plants)",
       subtitle = paste("Kruskal-Wallis p =", signif(kw_test$p.value, 3)),
       y = "Number of ASVs") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())

print(p_alpha)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig2A_Alpha_Diversity.svg"), p_alpha, width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Fig. 2C - Beta diversity (NMDS, control plants)

```{r fig2c}
set.seed(123)
bray_dist_ctrl <- phyloseq::distance(ps16S_control_10_rare, method = "bray")
nmds_ctrl      <- ordinate(ps16S_control_10_rare, method = "NMDS", distance = "bray")

ctrl_metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_control_10_rare))
adonis_ctrl   <- adonis2(bray_dist_ctrl ~ Variety, data = ctrl_metadata,
                         permutations = 999, by = "terms")

r2_val     <- round(adonis_ctrl$R2[1], 3)
p_val      <- adonis_ctrl$`Pr(>F)`[1]
stress_val <- round(nmds_ctrl$stress, 3)

p_nmds <- plot_ordination(ps16S_control_10_rare, nmds_ctrl, color = "Variety") +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Variety), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.1, color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
  labs(title    = "C. NMDS - bacterial community (control roots)",
       subtitle = paste0("PERMANOVA R² = ", r2_val, " | p = ", p_val,
                         " | Stress = ", stress_val)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 11),
        legend.title  = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_nmds)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig2C_NMDS_Control.svg"), p_nmds, width = 5, height = 3)
```

## Fig. 2E - Complementary analyses to Fig. 2C (distances, dispersion, pairwise PERMANOVA)

```{r fig2e}
set.seed(123)

# 1) Metadata
meta_ctrl <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_control_10_rare))
meta_ctrl$SampleID <- rownames(meta_ctrl)
meta_ctrl <- dplyr::select(meta_ctrl, SampleID, Variety)

lvl <- intersect(names(colors_Variety), unique(meta_ctrl$Variety))
meta_ctrl$Variety <- factor(meta_ctrl$Variety, levels = lvl)

# 2) Bray-Curtis distances
otu_mat   <- as.matrix(otu_table(ps16S_control_10_rare))
bray_dist <- vegdist(otu_mat, method = "bray")
bray_mat  <- as.matrix(bray_dist)

# 3) All pairwise sample distances
pairs_df <- as.data.frame(t(combn(rownames(bray_mat), 2)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(pairs_df) <- c("Sample1", "Sample2")
pairs_df$Distance  <- bray_mat[cbind(pairs_df$Sample1, pairs_df$Sample2)]

pairs_df <- pairs_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::rename(meta_ctrl, Var1 = Variety), by = c("Sample1" = "SampleID")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::rename(meta_ctrl, Var2 = Variety), by = c("Sample2" = "SampleID")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Var1       = as.character(Var1),
    Var2       = as.character(Var2),
    Comparison = ifelse(Var1 == Var2, "Intra-variety", "Inter-variety"),
    VarA       = pmin(Var1, Var2),   # unordered pair key
    VarB       = pmax(Var1, Var2)
  )

# 4) Intra- vs inter-variety distances
# Note: pairwise distances are not independent observations; this Wilcoxon p-value
# is descriptive. The formal test is the PERMANOVA (Fig. 2C).
wilcox_p <- wilcox.test(Distance ~ Comparison, data = pairs_df)$p.value

p_intra_inter <- ggplot(pairs_df, aes(x = Comparison, y = Distance)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "grey90") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Community dissimilarity: intra- vs inter-variety",
       subtitle = paste("Wilcoxon p =", signif(wilcox_p, 3)),
       y = "Bray-Curtis distance", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# 5) Multivariate dispersion (betadisper + permutation test)
bd      <- betadisper(bray_dist, meta_ctrl$Variety)
bd_test <- permutest(bd, permutations = 999)
bd_p    <- bd_test$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]

disp_df <- data.frame(SampleID = names(bd$distances),
                      Distance = bd$distances,
                      Variety  = bd$group)

p_disp <- ggplot(disp_df, aes(x = Variety, y = Distance, fill = Variety)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
  labs(title = "Multivariate dispersion (betadisper)",
       subtitle = paste("Distance to group centroid | permutest p =", signif(bd_p, 3)),
       y = "Distance to centroid", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"))

# 6) Pairwise PERMANOVA (BH-adjusted)
pairs_levels <- combn(levels(meta_ctrl$Variety), 2, simplify = FALSE)

pw_table <- lapply(pairs_levels, function(p) {
  sub_meta <- dplyr::filter(meta_ctrl, Variety %in% p)
  sub_meta$Variety <- droplevels(sub_meta$Variety)
  sub_dist <- as.dist(bray_mat[sub_meta$SampleID, sub_meta$SampleID])
  ad <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ Variety, data = sub_meta, permutations = 999, by = "terms")
  data.frame(Var1 = p[1], Var2 = p[2], R2 = ad$R2[1], pval = ad$`Pr(>F)`[1])
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))

write.xlsx(pw_table, file.path(output_dir, "Table_Fig2E_Pairwise_PERMANOVA_Control.xlsx"))

# 7) Heatmap: mean distance per pair of varieties + PERMANOVA significance
mean_dist <- pairs_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(VarA, VarB) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(MeanDist = mean(Distance), .groups = "drop")

heatmap_df <- expand.grid(Var1 = lvl, Var2 = lvl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(VarA = pmin(Var1, Var2), VarB = pmax(Var1, Var2)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mean_dist, by = c("VarA", "VarB")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = lvl),
                Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = lvl))

stars_df <- pw_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Label = dplyr::case_when(p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                         p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                         p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                         TRUE          ~ ""),
                Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = lvl),
                Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = lvl))

p_heat <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = MeanDist)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
                       name = "Mean Bray-Curtis\ndistance") +
  geom_text(data = stars_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, label = Label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6) +
  labs(title = "Pairwise community dissimilarity and PERMANOVA",
       subtitle = "Colour = mean Bray-Curtis distance | Stars = BH-adjusted p-value",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 8) Combined panels
fig2e <- (p_intra_inter | p_disp) / p_heat
print(fig2e)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig2E_Distances_Dispersion_PairwisePERMANOVA.svg"),
       fig2e, width = 13, height = 11)
```

## Fig. 3 - Venn diagram and core microbiota (control plants)

```{r fig3}
# All Fig. 3 computations use the same object (non-rarefied control plants,
# ASVs >= 10 reads) so that numerators and denominators are comparable.
ps_core           <- ps16S_control_10
otu_controls      <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_core))
metadata_controls <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_core))

# Core criteria within each variety
min_abundance <- 100   # minimum total reads in the variety
min_prev      <- 0.8   # minimum prevalence (80 % of the variety's samples)

varieties_ctrl <- unique(metadata_controls$Variety)

otu_list_venn_ct <- lapply(varieties_ctrl, function(var) {
  samples <- intersect(rownames(metadata_controls)[metadata_controls$Variety == var],
                       rownames(otu_controls))
  if (length(samples) == 0) return(character(0))
  otu_subset      <- otu_controls[samples, , drop = FALSE]
  pass_abundance  <- colSums(otu_subset) >= min_abundance
  pass_prevalence <- colMeans(otu_subset > 0) >= min_prev
  colnames(otu_subset)[pass_abundance & pass_prevalence]
})
names(otu_list_venn_ct) <- varieties_ctrl

# ---- Core microbiota statistics ----------------------------------------------
core_asvs <- Reduce(intersect, otu_list_venn_ct)

total_asvs_count  <- ntaxa(ps_core)
total_reads_count <- sum(otu_controls)
core_asvs_count   <- length(core_asvs)
core_reads_count  <- sum(otu_controls[, core_asvs, drop = FALSE])

prop_diversity <- 100 * core_asvs_count / total_asvs_count
prop_abundance <- 100 * core_reads_count / total_reads_count

cat("\n================ CORE MICROBIOTA ================\n")
cat("Total ASVs                : ", total_asvs_count, "\n")
cat("Core ASVs                 : ", core_asvs_count, "\n")
cat("Proportion of diversity   : ", round(prop_diversity, 2), "%\n")
cat("Total reads               : ", total_reads_count, "\n")
cat("Core reads                : ", core_reads_count, "\n")
cat("Proportion of abundance   : ", round(prop_abundance, 2), "%\n")
cat("=================================================\n\n")

# ---- Venn diagram ------------------------------------------------------------
venn <- ggVennDiagram(otu_list_venn_ct,
                      set_color   = colors_Variety[names(otu_list_venn_ct)],
                      set_size    = 5,
                      label       = "count",
                      label_alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = color_venn[["low"]], high = color_venn[["high"]],
                      name = "ASV count") +
  labs(title = "Core microbiota - shared ASVs (control roots)") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(venn)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig3_Venn_Core_Roots.svg"), venn, width = 8, height = 6)

# ---- Core taxonomic composition ----------------------------------------------
tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_core), "matrix"))
tax_df$ASV <- rownames(tax_df)

core_abundance <- colSums(otu_controls[, core_asvs, drop = FALSE])
df_core <- data.frame(ASV = names(core_abundance), Abundance = as.numeric(core_abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV")

# (a) Donut chart by genus
min_pct_other <- 2   # genera < 2 % grouped into "Other"

core_summary <- df_core %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus), Genus != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * TotalAbundance / sum(TotalAbundance),
                DisplayGroup = ifelse(pct < min_pct_other, "Other", Genus)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(DisplayGroup) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(TotalAbundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * TotalAbundance / sum(TotalAbundance), 1)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(pct))

pal_vec <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(nrow(core_summary))
names(pal_vec) <- core_summary$DisplayGroup
if ("Other" %in% names(pal_vec)) pal_vec["Other"] <- "grey80"

donut_core <- ggplot(core_summary,
                     aes(x = 2, y = pct, fill = fct_reorder(DisplayGroup, pct))) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(DisplayGroup, " (", pct, "%)")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_vec, name = "Genus") +
  labs(title = "Core microbiota composition (genus)",
       subtitle = paste0("Core = ", round(prop_abundance, 1), "% of total reads")) +
  theme_void()

print(donut_core)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig3_Core_Donut_Genus.svg"), donut_core, width = 8, height = 6)

# (b) Donut chart by genus, coloured by family
min_pct_label <- 2   # labels shown for genera >= 2 %

core_summary_fam <- df_core %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus), Genus != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus, Family) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct          = 100 * Abundance / sum(Abundance),
                Genus_Group  = ifelse(pct < min_pct_other, "Other", Genus),
                Family_Group = ifelse(pct < min_pct_other, "Other", Family)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus_Group, Family_Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pct = sum(pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Family_Group, dplyr::desc(pct))

levels_fam <- unique(core_summary_fam$Family_Group)
levels_fam <- c(setdiff(levels_fam, "Other"), intersect("Other", levels_fam))

core_summary_fam <- core_summary_fam %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Genus_Group  = factor(Genus_Group, levels = unique(Genus_Group)),
                Family_Group = factor(Family_Group, levels = levels_fam),
                Label = ifelse(pct >= min_pct_label,
                               paste0(Genus_Group, "\n(", round(pct, 1), "%)"), ""))

# Family palette (families absent from this list are drawn in grey)
family_colors <- c("Burkholderiaceae"     = "#FC7A57",
                   "Comamonadaceae"       = "#28666E",
                   "Rhizobiaceae"         = "#B5B682",
                   "Xanthobacteraceae"    = "#B2DF8A",
                   "Sphingomonadaceae"    = "#FCD757",
                   "Beijerinckiaceae"     = "#FDBF6F",
                   "Chitinophagaceae"     = "#574D68",
                   "Solirubrobacteraceae" = "#CAB2D6",
                   "Solimonadaceae"       = "#94D1BE",
                   "Holophagaceae"        = "#B15928",
                   "Other"                = "#D3D3D3")

donut_core_fam <- ggplot(core_summary_fam, aes(x = 2, y = pct, fill = Family_Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = family_colors, name = "Family", na.value = "grey60") +
  labs(title = "Core microbiota (genus)", subtitle = "Grouped by family") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(donut_core_fam)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig3_Core_Donut_Family.svg"), donut_core_fam, width = 10, height = 7)
```

```{r fig4a}
# Pielou's evenness J = H / ln(S)
table_variety$Evenness <- table_variety$Shannon / log(table_variety$Observed)

datar.variety <- cbind(data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10)), table_variety)
```

## Fig. 4B - Beta diversity: effect of inoculation within each variety

```{r fig4b}
sample_metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10_rare))
sample_metadata$SampleID <- rownames(sample_metadata)

otu_mat   <- as.matrix(otu_table(ps16S_Root_10_rare))
bray_dist <- vegdist(otu_mat, method = "bray")

# Common size scale across varieties
global_symptom_range <- range(sample_metadata$Symptoms_up, na.rm = TRUE)

for (current_var in unique(sample_metadata$Variety)) {

  subset_info <- dplyr::filter(sample_metadata, Variety == current_var)
  if (nrow(subset_info) < 3) next

  subset_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(bray_dist)[subset_info$SampleID, subset_info$SampleID])

  set.seed(123)
  nmds_res <- tryCatch(metaMDS(subset_dist, k = 2, trymax = 100, trace = FALSE),
                       error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(nmds_res)) next

  nmds_plot_df <- as.data.frame(nmds_res$points)
  nmds_plot_df$SampleID <- rownames(nmds_plot_df)
  nmds_plot_df <- dplyr::left_join(nmds_plot_df, subset_info, by = "SampleID")
  nmds_plot_df$Group <- paste(current_var, nmds_plot_df$Condition, sep = "_")

  # PERMANOVA: Condition effect within the variety
  set.seed(123)
  perm_res <- adonis2(subset_dist ~ Condition, data = subset_info,
                      permutations = 999, by = "terms")

  stats_label <- paste0("Stress = ", round(nmds_res$stress, 3),
                        " | R² = ", round(perm_res$R2[1], 3),
                        " | p = ", round(perm_res$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3))

  p_var <- ggplot(nmds_plot_df, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2,
                                    color = Condition,   # outline (points + ellipses)
                                    fill  = Group,       # ellipse fill
                                    size  = Symptoms_up)) +
    stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Symptoms (cm)", range = c(2, 8),
                          limits = global_symptom_range) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    labs(title = paste("Variety:", current_var), subtitle = stats_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic"))

  print(p_var)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Fig4B_NMDS_", current_var, "_Inoculation.svg")),
         p_var, width = 6, height = 5)
}
```

## Fig. 5 - Global effect of inoculation (DESeq2, volcano and Manhattan plots)

```{r fig5}
# Non-rarefied counts
ps <- ps16S_Root_10

# Model: Variety included as covariate to isolate the inoculation effect
dds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(ps, ~ Variety + Condition)
dds$Condition <- relevel(factor(dds$Condition), ref = "Control")

# Note: if DESeq() fails with "every gene contains at least one zero",
# add sfType = "poscounts" (recommended for sparse microbiome data).
dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")

res     <- results(dds, contrast = c("Condition", "Inoculated", "Control"))
res_shr <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "Condition_Inoculated_vs_Control", type = "apeglm")

out <- as.data.frame(res_shr) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pvalue = res$pvalue,
                padj   = res$padj,
                ASV    = rownames(res_shr))

tax <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps), "matrix"))
tax$ASV <- rownames(tax)

out <- dplyr::left_join(out, tax, by = "ASV") %>% dplyr::arrange(pvalue)
write.xlsx(out, file.path(output_dir, "Table_Fig5_DESeq2_Global_Inoculated_vs_Control.xlsx"))

# ---- Parameters --------------------------------------------------------------
use_p       <- "pvalue"   # "pvalue" (nominal) or "padj" (BH-adjusted)
alpha       <- 0.05
label_top   <- 25
jitter_w    <- 0.28
top_phyla   <- 10
size_breaks <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.50, 1.00)

# ---- Summary of significant ASVs ---------------------------------------------
sig <- dplyr::filter(out, !is.na(.data[[use_p]]), .data[[use_p]] < alpha)
message("Significant ASVs (", use_p, " < ", alpha, "): ", nrow(sig))

by_phylum <- sig %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Phylum = as.character(Phylum)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_sig      = dplyr::n(),
                   n_enriched = sum(log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_depleted = sum(log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_enriched))
print(by_phylum)

# ---- Volcano plot ------------------------------------------------------------
p_volcano <- ggplot(out, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(.data[[use_p]]))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = .data[[use_p]] < alpha), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#D55E00"),
                     name = paste0("Significant (", use_p, " < ", alpha, ")")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "Global differential abundance: inoculated vs control",
       subtitle = "Adjusted for variety effect",
       x = "log2 fold change (inoculated / control)",
       y = paste0("-log10(", use_p, ")")) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_volcano)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Fig5_Volcano_", use_p, ".svg")), p_volcano, width = 7, height = 5)

# ---- Manhattan plot ----------------------------------------------------------
ra_pct <- 100 * taxa_sums(ps) / sum(taxa_sums(ps))
ra_df  <- tibble::tibble(ASV = names(ra_pct), rel_abund_pct = as.numeric(ra_pct))

P_vec <- as.numeric(out[[use_p]])
P_vec[!is.finite(P_vec) | P_vec <= 0] <- NA_real_

df0 <- out %>%
  dplyr::mutate(P = P_vec, y = -log10(pmin(pmax(P_vec, 1e-300), 1))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ra_df, by = "ASV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "", "Others", as.character(Phylum)),
                Order  = ifelse(is.na(Order)  | Order  == "", "Unclassified", as.character(Order)),
                rel_abund_pct = tidyr::replace_na(rel_abund_pct, 0),
                sig = is.finite(P) & P < alpha) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(y))

make_manh <- function(df0, direction = c("enriched", "depleted"),
                      top_phyla = 10, alpha = 0.05, label_top = 25,
                      jitter_w = 0.28, bg_alpha = 0.10,
                      palette_cols = c("#78A1BB", "#EEB902", "#7776BC", "#EC7357", "#28AFB0",
                                       "#97CC04", "#E13700", "#C09BD8", "#337CA0")) {

  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  if (direction == "enriched") {
    df_sub <- dplyr::filter(df0, log2FoldChange > 0)
    ttl    <- "Global DA - enriched ASVs (log2FC > 0)"
  } else {
    df_sub <- dplyr::filter(df0, log2FoldChange < 0)
    ttl    <- "Global DA - depleted ASVs (log2FC < 0)"
  }

  # Phyla ordered by number of ASVs; less frequent phyla grouped as "Others"
  ph_order <- df_sub %>%
    dplyr::count(Phylum, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Phylum)
  keep    <- head(ph_order, top_phyla)
  df_sub  <- dplyr::mutate(df_sub, Phylum2 = ifelse(Phylum %in% keep, Phylum, "Others"))
  ph_axis <- c(keep, setdiff("Others", keep))

  # Orders indexed within each phylum (x position)
  ord_map <- df_sub %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Phylum2, Order) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(factor(Phylum2, levels = ph_axis), Order) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Phylum2) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ord_idx = match(Order, unique(Order))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  ph_info <- ord_map %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Phylum2) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_ord = max(ord_idx), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(factor(Phylum2, levels = ph_axis)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(start = c(0, head(cumsum(n_ord), -1)),
                  mid   = start + n_ord / 2 + 0.5)

  set.seed(1)
  df_plot <- df_sub %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ord_map, by = c("Phylum2", "Order")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ph_info, by = "Phylum2") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(x = start + ord_idx + runif(dplyr::n(), -jitter_w, jitter_w))

  pal <- stats::setNames(grDevices::colorRampPalette(palette_cols)(length(ph_axis)), ph_axis)
  pal["Others"] <- "#9E9E9E"

  bg <- dplyr::mutate(ph_info, xmin = start + 0.5, xmax = start + n_ord + 0.5)

  # Labels for the top significant ASVs
  lab_df <- df_plot %>%
    dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(P, dplyr::desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = label_top) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genus   = dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(Genus)), ""),
      Species = dplyr::na_if(trimws(as.character(Species)), ""),
      Species = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(Species) & tolower(Species) %in% c("sp.", "sp", "uncultured", "uncultured bacterium"),
        NA_character_, Species),
      line1 = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(Genus) & !is.na(Species) ~ paste0(Genus, "_", Species),
                               !is.na(Genus)                   ~ paste0(Genus, "_sp."),
                               TRUE                            ~ "Unassigned"),
      label = paste0(line1, "\n(", ASV, ")")
    )

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_rect(data = bg,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Phylum2),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = bg_alpha, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = 2, color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(aes(color = Phylum2, size = rel_abund_pct), alpha = 0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab_df, aes(label = label, color = Phylum2),
                             size = 3.1, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1,
                             box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.25,
                             segment.alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = "Phylum") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.6, 6.2), breaks = size_breaks,
                          labels = paste0(size_breaks, "%"),
                          name = "Relative abundance (%)") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 6, alpha = 1),
                                keywidth = unit(8, "mm"), keyheight = unit(8, "mm"),
                                title.position = "top"),
           size  = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = ph_info$mid, labels = ph_info$Phylum2,
                       expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
    labs(title = ttl,
         subtitle = paste0("ASVs plotted by -log10(", if (use_p == "padj") "FDR" else "p-value",
                           ") per phylum"),
         x = NULL,
         y = if (use_p == "padj") expression(-log[10]("FDR")) else expression(-log[10](p-value))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position    = "right",
          legend.key.size    = unit(9, "mm"),
          legend.text        = element_text(size = 11),
          legend.title       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
}

p_enr <- make_manh(df0, "enriched", top_phyla = top_phyla, alpha = alpha,
                   label_top = label_top, jitter_w = jitter_w)
p_dep <- make_manh(df0, "depleted", top_phyla = top_phyla, alpha = alpha,
                   label_top = label_top, jitter_w = jitter_w)
print(p_enr); print(p_dep)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Fig5_Manhattan_Enriched_", use_p, ".svg")), p_enr, width = 12, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Fig5_Manhattan_Depleted_", use_p, ".svg")), p_dep, width = 12, height = 7)
```

## Fig. 6 - Differential abundance per variety (ALDEx2)

```{r fig6-aldex2}
set.seed(123)   # ALDEx2 Monte-Carlo sampling

# P-value column used for significance:
#   "wi.ep"  = expected Wilcoxon p-value (nominal)
#   "wi.eBH" = expected Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value (recommended)
aldex_p_col   <- "wi.ep"
aldex_eff_min <- 1      # minimum |median CLR difference|

varieties <- unique(as.character(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10)$Variety))
all_genus_results <- list()
all_asv_results   <- list()

run_aldex <- function(ps_obj) {
  otu <- otu_table(ps_obj)
  if (!taxa_are_rows(otu)) otu <- t(otu)
  conds <- as.character(sample_data(ps_obj)$Condition)
  clr   <- aldex.clr(as.data.frame(otu), conds = conds, mc.samples = 128,
                     denom = "all", verbose = FALSE)
  # diff.btw = Inoculated - Control (conditions in alphabetical order)
  data.frame(aldex.ttest(clr, paired.test = FALSE), aldex.effect(clr))
}

# ---- Genus level -------------------------------------------------------------
for (variety in varieties) {
  message("ALDEx2 (genus): ", variety)
  ps_variety <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10)$Variety == variety, ps16S_Root_10)
  ps_genus   <- tax_glom(ps_variety, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)

  res <- run_aldex(ps_genus)
  res$Feature <- rownames(res)
  res$Variety <- variety

  tax <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_genus), "matrix"))
  tax$Feature <- rownames(tax)
  res_annot <- merge(res, tax, by = "Feature")

  all_genus_results[[variety]] <- dplyr::filter(
    res_annot, .data[[aldex_p_col]] < 0.05 & abs(diff.btw) > aldex_eff_min)
}

# ---- ASV level ---------------------------------------------------------------
for (variety in varieties) {
  message("ALDEx2 (ASV): ", variety)
  ps_variety <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10)$Variety == variety, ps16S_Root_10)

  res <- run_aldex(ps_variety)
  res$ASV     <- rownames(res)
  res$Variety <- variety

  tax <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_variety), "matrix"))
  tax$ASV     <- rownames(tax)
  tax$Feature <- paste(tax$Genus, tax$Species, tax$ASV, sep = "_")
  res <- merge(res, tax, by = "ASV")

  all_asv_results[[variety]] <- dplyr::filter(
    res, .data[[aldex_p_col]] < 0.05 & abs(diff.btw) > aldex_eff_min)
}

final_genus_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_genus_results)
final_asv_df   <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_asv_results)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Significant_Genera")
writeData(wb, "Significant_Genera", final_genus_df)
addWorksheet(wb, "Significant_ASVs")
writeData(wb, "Significant_ASVs", final_asv_df)
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(output_dir, "Table_Fig6_ALDEx2_by_Variety.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

# ---- Bubble plot -------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean relative abundance (%) of each genus per variety (non-rarefied data)
ps_rel       <- transform_sample_counts(ps16S_Root_10, function(x) 100 * x / sum(x))
ps_genus_rel <- tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)

abundance_stats <- psmelt(ps_genus_rel) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variety, Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

plot_df <- final_genus_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(abundance_stats, by = c("Variety", "Genus")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(diff.btw)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Genus = reorder(Genus, diff.btw))

p_aldex <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = diff.btw, y = Genus, color = Variety)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = MeanAbundance), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Mean rel. abundance (%)", range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(title = "Differentially abundant genera (ALDEx2)",
       subtitle = "Point size = mean relative abundance within each variety",
       x = "Median CLR difference (Control < 0 < Inoculated)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "italic"))

print(p_aldex)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig6_ALDEx2_Genus_BubblePlot.svg"), p_aldex, width = 6, height = 6)
```

## Fig. 6 (complement) - ANCOM-BC2 per variety and concordance with ALDEx2

```{r fig6-ancombc2}
set.seed(123)

all_genus_results_ancombc      <- list()   # significant genera (q < 0.05)
all_genus_results_ancombc_full <- list()   # all tested genera

for (variety in varieties) {
  message("ANCOM-BC2 (genus): ", variety)
  ps_variety <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10)$Variety == variety, ps16S_Root_10)

  ancombc_out <- ancombc2(data = ps_variety, tax_level = "Genus",
                          fix_formula = "Condition", group = "Condition",
                          p_adj_method = "holm", prv_cut = 0, lib_cut = 0,
                          s0_perc = 0.05, struc_zero = TRUE, neg_lb = TRUE,
                          alpha = 0.05, n_cl = 1, verbose = FALSE)

  res_clean <- ancombc_out$res %>%
    dplyr::select(Genus     = taxon,
                  lfc       = lfc_ConditionInoculated,
                  p_val     = p_ConditionInoculated,
                  q_val     = q_ConditionInoculated,
                  passed_ss = passed_ss_ConditionInoculated,
                  diff_ab   = diff_ConditionInoculated)
  res_clean$Variety <- variety

  ps_genus_annot <- tax_glom(ps_variety, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)
  tax <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_genus_annot), "matrix"))
  res_annot <- merge(res_clean, tax, by = "Genus", all.x = TRUE)

  all_genus_results_ancombc_full[[variety]] <- res_annot
  all_genus_results_ancombc[[variety]]      <- dplyr::filter(res_annot, q_val < 0.05)
}

# ---- Concordance: genera significant with BOTH methods -----------------------
concordant_results <- list()
comparison_summary <- list()

for (variety in varieties) {
  aldex_sig   <- all_genus_results[[variety]] %>%
    dplyr::select(Genus, diff_ALDEx2 = diff.btw, p_ALDEx2 = dplyr::all_of(aldex_p_col))
  ancombc_sig <- all_genus_results_ancombc[[variety]] %>%
    dplyr::select(Genus, lfc_ANCOMBC2 = lfc, q_ANCOMBC2 = q_val)

  merged <- dplyr::inner_join(aldex_sig, ancombc_sig, by = "Genus") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(same_direction = sign(diff_ALDEx2) == sign(lfc_ANCOMBC2),
                  Variety = variety)

  concordant_results[[variety]] <- merged
  comparison_summary[[variety]] <- data.frame(
    Variety                     = variety,
    n_ALDEx2                    = nrow(aldex_sig),
    n_ANCOMBC2                  = nrow(ancombc_sig),
    n_Concordant_total          = nrow(merged),
    n_Concordant_same_direction = sum(merged$same_direction, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

summary_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(comparison_summary)
print(summary_table)

# ---- Excel export (rows with discordant direction highlighted) ---------------
wb <- createWorkbook()
header_style  <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = "#D9E1F2", border = "Bottom")
discord_style <- createStyle(fgFill = "#FCE4D6")

addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
writeData(wb, "Summary", summary_table)
addStyle(wb, "Summary", header_style, rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(summary_table)), gridExpand = TRUE)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(summary_table))) {
  if (summary_table$n_Concordant_same_direction[i] < summary_table$n_Concordant_total[i]) {
    addStyle(wb, "Summary", discord_style, rows = i + 1,
             cols = seq_len(ncol(summary_table)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }
}

for (variety in varieties) {
  df <- concordant_results[[variety]]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) next
  sheet_name <- substr(paste0("Detail_", variety), 1, 31)   # Excel limit: 31 characters
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, df)
  addStyle(wb, sheet_name, header_style, rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(df)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  discord_rows <- which(!df$same_direction) + 1             # +1: header row
  if (length(discord_rows) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet_name, discord_style, rows = discord_rows,
             cols = seq_len(ncol(df)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }
}

addWorksheet(wb, "ANCOMBC2_all_genera")
writeData(wb, "ANCOMBC2_all_genera", dplyr::bind_rows(all_genus_results_ancombc_full))

saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(output_dir, "Table_ALDEx2_vs_ANCOMBC2_Concordance.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Fig. 6 (alternative) - DESeq2 per variety

```{r fig6-deseq2}
# Non-rarefied counts, ASVs with >= 100 reads in total
ps16S_Root_100 <- phyloseq::filter_taxa(ps16S_Root, function(x) sum(x) >= 100, prune = TRUE)

deseq_variety_results <- list()

for (current_var in unique(as.character(sample_data(ps16S_Root_100)$Variety))) {
  message("DESeq2: ", current_var)
  ps_sub <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps16S_Root_100)$Variety == current_var, ps16S_Root_100)
  sample_data(ps_sub)$Condition <- factor(sample_data(ps_sub)$Condition,
                                          levels = c("Control", "Inoculated"))

  dds_sub <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(ps_sub, ~ Condition)
  dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")
  res_v   <- results(dds_sub, contrast = c("Condition", "Inoculated", "Control"))

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res_v) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Variety = current_var)
  tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_sub), "matrix")) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")
  res_df <- dplyr::left_join(res_df, tax_df, by = "ASV")

  # Nominal significance (unadjusted p < 0.05); use padj for an FDR-controlled list
  res_sig <- dplyr::filter(res_df, !is.na(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05)
  if (nrow(res_sig) > 0) deseq_variety_results[[current_var]] <- res_sig
}

final_deseq_var_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(deseq_variety_results)
write.xlsx(final_deseq_var_df, file.path(output_dir, "Table_Fig6_DESeq2_by_Variety.xlsx"))

# Mean relative abundance per genus and variety
ps_rel       <- transform_sample_counts(ps16S_Root_100, function(x) 100 * x / sum(x))
ps_genus_rel <- tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)
abundance_stats <- psmelt(ps_genus_rel) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variety, Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

# ASV results summarised at genus level (mean log2FC, minimum p-value)
plot_deseq_df <- final_deseq_var_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variety, Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(log2FoldChange = mean(log2FoldChange),
                   pvalue         = min(pvalue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(abundance_stats, by = c("Variety", "Genus")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Genus = reorder(Genus, log2FoldChange))

p_deseq_var <- ggplot(plot_deseq_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = Genus, color = Variety)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = MeanAbundance), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Mean rel. abundance (%)", range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(title = "Differentially abundant genera per variety (DESeq2)",
       subtitle = "Nominal significance (unadjusted p < 0.05)",
       x = "log2 fold change (inoculated / control)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "italic"))

print(p_deseq_var)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig6_DESeq2_Variety_BubblePlot.svg"), p_deseq_var, width = 10, height = 7)
```

# 9. Statistical tables

## Table 1 - Global PERMANOVA

```{r permanova}
otu_table_matrix <- as.matrix(otu_table(ps16S_Root_10_rare))
bray_dist        <- vegdist(otu_table_matrix, method = "bray")
sample_metadata  <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10_rare))

# Variety, Condition and their interaction (sequential sums of squares, by = "terms")
set.seed(123)
permanova_global <- adonis2(bray_dist ~ Variety * Condition,
                            data = sample_metadata, permutations = 999, by = "terms")
print(permanova_global)
write.csv(as.data.frame(permanova_global),
          file.path(output_dir, "Table1_Global_PERMANOVA_Variety_Condition.csv"))

# Does symptom severity explain community variation? (samples without symptom data removed)
set.seed(123)
permanova_symptoms <- adonis2(bray_dist ~ Symptoms_up + Variety,
                              data = sample_metadata, permutations = 999, by = "terms",
                              na.action = na.omit)
print(permanova_symptoms)
write.csv(as.data.frame(permanova_symptoms),
          file.path(output_dir, "Table_PERMANOVA_Symptoms_Variety.csv"))
```

```{r figS1}
make_rarecurve <- function(ps_obj, title, xmax) {
  ggrare(ps_obj, step = 100, se = FALSE, color = "Variety", plot = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Sequencing depth (reads)", y = "Number of ASVs") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
          axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text    = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 12))
}
```

## Fig. S4 - Phenotypes (symptoms and plant size)

```{r figS4}
pheno_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_Root_10_rare)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Symptoms_up = as.numeric(Symptoms_up),
                Size        = as.numeric(Size))

# Compact letter display from pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
get_significance_letters <- function(data, value_col, group_col, p_adjust = "BH") {
  pwc   <- pairwise.wilcox.test(data[[value_col]], data[[group_col]],
                                p.adjust.method = p_adjust, exact = FALSE)
  p_mat <- pwc$p.value
  p_vec <- c()
  for (r in rownames(p_mat)) for (c in colnames(p_mat)) {
    if (!is.na(p_mat[r, c])) p_vec[paste(r, c, sep = "-")] <- p_mat[r, c]
  }
  cld <- multcompLetters(p_vec, compare = "<", threshold = 0.05, Letters = letters)
  data.frame(Variety = names(cld$Letters), Letter = unname(cld$Letters))
}

plot_pheno <- function(df, value_col, title, ylab) {
  kw      <- kruskal.test(df[[value_col]] ~ df$Variety)
  letters_df <- get_significance_letters(df, value_col, "Variety")
  max_vals <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Variety) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(MaxY = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(letters_df, by = "Variety")

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Variety, y = .data[[value_col]], fill = Variety)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
    geom_text(data = max_vals, aes(x = Variety, y = MaxY, label = Letter),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_Variety) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(kw$p.value, 3),
                           " | letters: pairwise Wilcoxon, BH-adjusted"),
         y = ylab, x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

# (A) Symptoms - inoculated plants only
df_symp <- dplyr::filter(pheno_df, Condition == "Inoculated", !is.na(Symptoms_up))
p_symptoms <- plot_pheno(df_symp, "Symptoms_up",
                         "Symptom severity (inoculated plants)", "Lesion length (cm)")
print(p_symptoms)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS4A_Boxplot_Symptoms_Inoculated.svg"), p_symptoms, width = 6, height = 4)

# (B) Plant height - control plants only
df_size <- dplyr::filter(pheno_df, Condition == "Control", !is.na(Size))
p_size <- plot_pheno(df_size, "Size", "Plant growth (control plants)", "Plant height (cm)")
print(p_size)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigS4B_Boxplot_Size_Control.svg"), p_size, width = 6, height = 4)
```
